summary:
Plan of w210 (supervision r135, r136) at .shop/scratch/3-plan/plan.md, the first plan's two questions settled by the answers of 2026-10-27.
r135: new scripts/supervise_raise.py raises each `requests` entry of an integrate result with `work request` at the upstream's repository (parent of the Upstreams spec path), --from this context, --raised-for the fulfilled request, its delegation if any; w210 builds `work request --raised-for` (requests r29).
Record: raised.jsonl line (upstream, request, initiative, status, round) committed with the round's proposals.
Order: r96/r107 checks, then the raise, then proposals and one commit. A failed raise (answer C): no proposal, nothing committed or pushed, branch at its pre-round head, .shop/work/ as committed, error naming round, upstream and work's reason; the round runs again (r93).
r136: draft_proposals skips a formulated proposal whose integrate round raised a request not delivered in the upstream; an unreadable upstream request holds it (answer A).
Broken test: spec-integration @r44 Givens must make ../billing-ctx a repository that keeps requests.
